chunks.heading: What changes
chunks.text: Starting January 1, 2027, adult Medicaid members receive an expanded preventive dental benefit with two cleanings and one set of X-rays per year at no cost.
chunks.embedText: Adult Dental Benefit Expansion (Effective 2027) | What changes | Starting January 1, 2027, adult Medicaid members receive an expanded preventive dental benefit with two cleanings and one set of X-rays per year at no cost.

chunks.heading: What to tell members now
chunks.text: Until the effective date, adult dental coverage stays as it is today. Do not quote the new benefit before January 1, 2027.
